messages:
Lena: Thanks everyone for staying after the all-hands. Opening this thread for follow-ups about the headcount plan and team shifts. Drop short Qs and we'll answer.
Devon: Quick: will managers be given additional headcount to backfill from reorg moves or is it central hiring?
Sam: Central hiring for the prioritized buckets. Managers can request headcount but approvals will go through the central planning queue this quarter.
Nora: Is there an ETA for the new org chart? I want to see reporting lines before planning my roadmap.
Priya: Were finishing approvals today. Public org chart (editable view) targeted for Wed EOD.
Devon: Any change to leveling bands for staff/lead roles after the split?
Sam: No band changes. We will map existing roles to the new teams 1:1 where possible. If band adjustments are needed we'll post rationale and comp touchpoints.
Nora: How will internal mobility work during the transition? open transfers?
Priya: Internal transfers are allowed. There will be a short "freeze" window during the final cutover (2 business days) to avoid conflicting moves. Otherwise apply via the usual internal reqs.
Lena: To add: were encouraging shadow periods before final transfers. Leads should plan 1-2 weeks of overlap.
Devon: For people managers, will bonus targets change if their team size shifts quickly?
Sam: No immediate bonus formula changes. Compensation will be reviewed if someone's scope changes materially for the quarter.
Nora: Anything special for contractors/temps affected by reorg?
Priya: Contractors will be handled case-by-case; staffing team will reach out to owners with recommended actions this week.
Devon: Are hiring priorities publicized somewhere? I remember product-facing roles were prioritized.
Priya: Yes  hiring map will be in Confluence: "Q3 hiring priorities". Link to be posted here when live.
Lena: Also flagging enterprise backlog: Dedicated & Private roles get greenlight for urgent reqs tied to existing deals.
HiringBot: Reminder: Internal candidate referral bonus window open until end of month. See #people-ops for details.
Nora: Appreciate the clarity. One more: will there be explicit mentoring support if our team loses a senior IC during moves?
Lena: Good point. Well fund temporary mentorship stipends and pair people for knowledge transfer. Leads: coordinate with People Ops.
Sam: If you want, send a short note with the role impact and we'll prioritize hires or mentors.
Devon: Thanks  sending list now.
Lena: Thanks all. If you have sensitive concerns, DM me or @Priya directly.
